paper.title_en: Thermodynamics of Kerr-Newman-Bertotti-Robinson black holes from background subtraction
paper.abstract_en: The non-asymptotic flatness of charged rotating black holes immersed in the Bertotti-Robinson magnetic field causes the ambiguity in the gauge choice for the time generator and the horizon electric potential. By using the newly established form of the integrability condition together with the gauge choice for the asymptotically flat charged rotating black holes as the initial condition, we have found that the gauge can be uniquely fixed. With this fixed gauge, we further obtain the mass and angular momentum by the background subtraction method with the Minkowski spacetime as the reference spacetime. As a result, not only is the first law of black hole thermodynamics automatically satisfied, but also both the CR relation and the Smarr formula are obeyed.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文针对Bertotti-Robinson磁场中带电旋转黑洞的规范选取歧义，利用可积性条件与背景减法确定质量与角动量，并检验热力学第一定律、Christodoulou-Ruffini关系与Smarr公式，属于黑洞热力学方向且理论深度较高，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 背景减法下的Kerr-Newman-Bertotti-Robinson黑洞热力学
decision.abstract_zh: 浸没在Bertotti-Robinson磁场中的带电旋转黑洞由于非渐近平坦性，导致时间生成元的规范选取和视界电势存在歧义。通过采用新建立的可积性条件形式，并以渐近平坦带电旋转黑洞的规范选取作为初始条件，我们发现规范可以被唯一固定。在此固定规范下，我们进一步以Minkowski时空作为参考时空，通过背景减法方法得到质量和角动量。结果，不仅黑洞热力学第一定律自动满足，而且CR关系和Smarr公式也都得到遵守。
